rule_for_financials: Financials-sector names: banks, insurers and asset managers are financial (the seed's definition). Brokers, exchanges and processors default to financial too (seed precedent, 51 of 52 Financials) unless SEC data meets the growth_compounder clause (>20% revenue growth on the latest fiscal year, the measure lthcs.pillars.adoption.compute_revenue_growth_yoy uses); MSCI is the seed's precedent for that exception.
rule_for_spin_offs: A spin-off is not an IPO: the 'IPO <5y ago' growth clause is not applied to it. The stage then follows the remaining clauses on SEC data.

sources.sec_companyfacts: https://data.sec.gov/api/xbrl/companyfacts/CIK##########.json (10-K / 10-Q facts only; DEF 14A pay-versus-performance facts excluded)

APO.reason: Asset manager with a retirement-services insurer (Athene): squarely the seed definition of financial (banks / insurance / asset managers). Revenue swings are insurance / investment-result driven (FY2023 +198% on the Athene merger, FY2024 -20%, FY2025 +22.7%), not a growth-company profile; GAAP profitable (FY2025 net income $3.49B). Kept financial.

listing.event: IPO (NYSE) of Apollo Global Management; current registrant CIK 1858681 is the 2022 Apollo/Athene holding company (S-4 effective 2021-11-04)

COIN.reason: Exchange: the seed and Wave A class every exchange (CME, ICE, NDAQ, CBOE) and processor as financial (51 of 52 Financials). Not a growth profile on SEC data: FY2025 revenue +9.4%, TTM to 2026-06-30 -10.4%, TTM GAAP net loss -$0.99B; listed 2021-04-14, so the IPO<5y clause no longer applies. Kept financial.

CPAY.reason: Payment processor: seed precedent (FI, FIS, GPN, JKHY) is financial. Fails the >20% growth test on the fiscal-year measure the pipeline uses (FY2025 revenue +13.9%, 3y CAGR 9.7%; only the acquisition-boosted TTM window reaches +20.4%); GAAP profitable, public since 2010. Kept financial.

HOOD.reason: Retail broker, not a bank / insurer / asset manager (the seed's definition of financial), and growth is its defining trait on every SEC measure: revenue FY2025 +51.6%, FY2024 +58.2%, 3y CAGR 48.8%, TTM +38.3%; GAAP profitable since FY2024 (FY2025 net income $1.88B, TTM $2.07B). Meets the heuristic's growth_compounder clause (>20% YoY); the seed's one Financials exception (MSCI -> growth_compounder) is the precedent. Changed to growth_compounder.

IBKR.reason: Broker, so the growth test decides; it falls just short on the fiscal-year measure: total net revenues FY2025 +19.7% (TTM +21.3%, 3y CAGR 26.5%). GAAP profitable (FY2025 net income to common $0.98B), public since 2007. Kept financial (default for Financials); borderline, re-check on the FY2026 10-K.
IBKR.pipeline_revenue_growth_note: pipeline concepts (Revenues / RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax); for IBKR that is commissions only, so total net revenues (RevenuesNetOfInterestExpense) are used above

ECHO.reason: Revenue down three straight years (FY2025 -5.2%, 3y CAGR -7.0%, TTM -5.2%); GAAP net loss FY2025 -$14.50B (incl. a $5.78B indefinite-lived intangible impairment) and TTM -$4.77B even after a +$8.46B Q2 2026 quarter; listed since 2008. The literal pre_profit_growth clause (negative GAAP earnings) is rejected: revenue is shrinking and the company is not pre-profit. Operational stress is in the numbers. Kept recovery_stabilization.

MRNA.reason: Revenue collapsed from $19.26B (FY2022) to $1.94B (FY2025; -40% FY2025, TTM -27.6%); GAAP losses FY2023-FY2025 and TTM (-$3.15B); IPO 2018. Not pre_profit_growth (GAAP profits of $12.2B / $8.4B in FY2021-22; revenue shrinking) and not yet recovery_rerating (no trough: revenue still falling). Kept recovery_stabilization; note the TTM loss has not narrowed yet (-$3.15B vs -$2.90B).

FDXF.reason: Spin-off, not an IPO, so the heuristic's 'IPO <5y ago' growth clause does not apply; no growth either: revenue FY2026 (May) -1.1%, FY2025 -5.6%. GAAP profitable (FY2026 net income $0.66B), market cap $16.9B (inside the $5B-$200B standard band). Not mature (<$200B), not pre-profit or in recovery. Changed to standard_compounder. (The seed applied the IPO clause literally to the SOLV / VLTO spin-offs; those entries are unchanged here.)

listing.event: spin-off from FedEx effective 2026-06-01 (8-K filed 2026-06-01, accession 0001104659-26-068521: FedEx distributed 80.1% of FedEx Freight common stock); the 2026-05-27 first trade is when-issued trading

HONA.reason: Spin-off, not an IPO, so the 'IPO <5y ago' growth clause does not apply; revenue +5.4% YoY in its first 10-Q (quarter to 2026-06-27: $4.52B vs $4.29B); GAAP net income positive ($0.25B that quarter); market cap $49.0B (inside the $5B-$200B band). Changed to standard_compounder. (SOLV / VLTO, earlier spin-offs the seed put in growth_compounder, are unchanged here.)

listing.event: spin-off from Honeywell effective 2026-06-29; regular-way trading on Nasdaq from 2026-06-29 under CUSIP 43849R105 (8-K filed 2026-06-29, accession 0001628280-26-045874); the 2026-06-15 first trade is when-issued trading
